It’s important to note that certain risks or events could push outcomes outside the stated intervals. Black swan events—highly unpredictable, far-reaching events—are generally not factored into standard forecasts or confidence intervals because of their rarity. However, understanding that such risks exist is important, as they underscore why confidence intervals can’t fully account for all possible outcomes.
